an8.6:1.1: aṭṭhime bhikkhave lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti loko ca aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati
an8.6:1.3: lābho ca alābho ca yaso ca ayaso ca nindā ca pasaṃsā ca sukhaṃ ca dukkhaṃ ca
an8.6:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti loko ca ime aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati
an8.6:2.1: assutavato bhikkhave puthujjanassa uppajjati lābhopi alābhopi yasopi ayasopi nindāpi pasaṃsāpi sukhaṃpi dukkhaṃpi
an8.6:2.2: sutavatopi bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa uppajjati lābhopi alābhopi yasopi ayasopi nindāpi pasaṃsāpi sukhaṃpi dukkhaṃpi
an8.6:2.3: tatra bhikkhave ko viseso ko adhippāyaso kiṃnānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti.
an8.6:2.4: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
an8.6:3.1: tenahi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
an8.6:3.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an8.6:3.7: so ca kho anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammoti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an8.6:3.17: tañca kho aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
an8.6:4.1: tassa lābhopi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati alābhopi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yasopi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati ayasopi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati nindāpi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati pasaṃsāpi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati sukhaṃpi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati dukkhaṃpi cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati
an8.6:4.6: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhasamāpanno na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
an8.6:5.1: sutavato ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa uppajjati lābho
an8.6:5.4: so ca kho anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an8.6:5.14: tañca kho aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti yathābhūtaṃ idaṃ dukkhaṃ tañca kho aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an8.6:6.1: tassa lābhopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati alābhopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yasopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati ayasopi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati nindāpi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati pasaṃsāpi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati sukhaṃpi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati dukkhaṃpi cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhati
an8.6:6.2: so ca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ nānurujjhati alābhe nappaṭivirujjhati
an8.6:6.6: so evaṃ anurodhavirodhavippahīno parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
an8.6:6.8: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyaso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti.
